mentions.name: Reportr
mentions.description: An AI client for data analysis that connects to databases via MCP servers and displays large volumes of data, offering a custom client experience where Claude desktop falls short.
mentions.problem: Claude desktop is not great at displaying large volumes of data when connected to databases through MCP servers; a custom client can do a much better job.
mentions.source_excerpt:
AI client for data analysis.

You can connect Claude desktop to databases using MCP servers, but Claude desktop is not great at displaying large volumes of data. A custom client can do a much better job.

https://reportr.com/
